entities.name: Solon
entities.description: A scholar, athlete and Champion of Oxus famous for completing Thassa's labyrinth.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the sea who blessed and marked Solon.

entities.name: Praxitelius
entities.description: The previous Champion of Oxus, whose skeleton Solon found.

entities.name: Dekella
entities.description: Thassa's bident at the center of the maze.

events.summary: Solon trains for seven years and enters the labyrinth, finding Praxitelius's skeleton and dagger.
events.quote: he discovered the skeleton of Praxitelius , the previous Champion of Oxus

events.summary: Solon kills a minotaur at the center of the maze with his only arrow.
events.quote: he encountered a minotaur and managed to kill it with his only arrow

events.summary: Solon dives for the bident but nearly drowns; naiads rescue him and Thassa marks his body with light.
events.quote: Thassa then drew a pattern of light into the skin of Solon's entire body and withdrew.

events.summary: Solon returns to Meletis hailed as a great warrior.
events.quote: He later returned to Meletis and was hailed as a great warrior

relations.quote: forever marked and blessed by his god
